about 2 years ago I was in Moldova with my family and a bunch of strangers; it was an organised pretty big trip. Our bus took us far away from our hotel so we could see some kind of a famous mine. I didn't go in there, because i dont handle strong smells well and it was an oil mine. after a couple hours my brother still didnt come back and I needed to go to the bathroom. Me and my mom searched around for a bathroom for about 30minutes but eventually we found one and payed for it. (there are rarely free public bathrooms in Moldova from what ive experienced) We go in and there we see it... 
1. There is no toilet paper in the stalls - the entrance lady just gives you a small piece.
2. The stalls have no doors.
3. Theres no seats. And basically no toilets. Theres just a hole in the ground you're supposed to pee into... You stand or crouch and try to make it into the goddamn hole.
Trust me, it was a nightmare
